title: IUCr Electron Crystallography School 2026 — companion website
description:
Companion website for the 2026 Electron Crystallography School, an IUCr satellite school held 8–10 August 2026 in Calgary, Canada, immediately before the 27th Congress and General Assembly of the International Union of Crystallography.

The site collects the three-day programme, the instructors, one page per lecture and practical demonstration, and installation instructions and tutorial datasets for the software used in the hands-on session (PETS2 + Jana2020 and DIALS + Phenix).

Note on this version: this release archives the site framework, programme, and software pages. The lecture and demonstration pages are placeholders; their content has not yet been converted from the speakers' slides.
